questions.1.1 Context: How does it work today? (high-level process, where it hurts). What triggered the request (audit, legislation, deadline, efficiency...)
questions.1.2 Business Problem: Who is affected? (users, teams, number of people / units — roughly)

questions.2.2 Success: Define 3–5 success criteria (measurable or observable). Priority: must-have / should-have / nice-to-have

questions.3.1 Scope — In/Out: In-scope: features / processes / reports / automations. Out-of-scope (what we are consciously not doing now)
questions.3.2 Boundaries: Dependencies: other teams, ongoing projects, SME availability

questions.4.1 Data & Systems: What data is needed, where does it come from, and who owns it? Data sensitivity (personal data, financial sensitivity, contracts)
questions.4.2 Integrations & Access: Integration needs (SAP, data marts, SharePoint, email, documents...)
